DELEGATE'S REPUTATION
WHAT THE DELEGATE DOES
1. Receives a portion of your yearly publishing rights
2. Activates claims for you when events fall within an agreed scope
3. Spares you from publishing every minor 'what if'
4. Stakes their own reputation on each claim they sign
5. Returns the rights to you the moment you revoke
I'll keep two for the things only I can speak to. The rest — handle them for me.
Within scope, on your behalf, with my own reputation alongside yours.
Like insurance for your reputational rights.
Outsource what you can't handle yourself. Stay in the loop. Pull the rights back any time.
* If the delegate acts outside the agreed scope, both their reputation and yours are publicly affected.
